I wrote `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/20/session-e00f55c9/sessions-and-tasks/mobile-sheet/well-asks/asks.md` in the main tree, not the qf-9 worktree, because that's where the data and the task folder live. It has 31 numbered items, each with the owner's quote, source and timestamp, and a one-line instruction.

1. **Where the dictation was.** The well, padding, header, footer and mic asks are in `public/ai/v-timqv56.jsonl`, the cloud voice session of 10-19 (17:29–18:12), not in `ux/Dictate/ai/v-*.jsonl`.
2. **The other source.** The down-arrow, snap, page-behind, compact-mode, reconnect and screenshot-method asks are in the owner's tab prompt from 10-20 at about 19:35, line 117 of `ai/2026/10/20/session-e00f55c9/page.jsonl`.
3. **Nothing there.** `ux/Dictate/ai/v-*.jsonl` has no sheet talk after 10-17. The 10-19 session folders hold only relays and briefs. `v-4lwslx3` stops at "the minimized view" before any sheet instructions.
4. **Already built.** A 10-19 minion built most padding, footer, mic-meter and tab-menu items in worktree qf-6 (commits `73f58d561` and `577d3356d`), unmerged. Auto-scroll with a scroll lock, the down-arrow decision, the page behind the sheet, and reconnect look unbuilt.
5. **The file.** Duplicate asks are grouped at the end. I did not touch anything else or commit.
